en: The image features a small Orthodox church or monastery set against a lush, forested hillside. The church has a steep, wooden-shingled roof with a prominent bell tower topped with a cross. The upper part of the building is decorated with colorful frescoes depicting religious figures. The entrance has arches with columns and a person dressed in black clerical attire standing in the doorway. There is an old-fashioned lamp post in the foreground, and the scene is surrounded by greenery under a blue sky.
